name: Modify code to implement specific graphical or image processing logic
description: Users asked to modify, complete, or debug existing code snippets primarily related to image processing, graphical user interface development, and basic algorithmic logic. The requests frequently involved implementing visual effects such as contrast adjustments and binarization, handling GUI layout and input, or fixing specific bugs in Java, Python, and JavaScript applications.
